caption: A ripple counter of copper bulbs wound up a spiral stair. A copper bulb flips (lit / unlit) each time its power rises; the button on bulb 0 flips it at every press. A comparator reads each bulb (15 while it is lit) into a stone, which powers that bit's output; a torch on the side of that stone is lit while the bulb is unlit and powers the next bulb, which stands on the torch: when a bulb goes out, its torch lights and flips the next bulb, so each bit flips when the bit below it goes from 1 to 0 (counting up). Each comparator stands on the stone of the stage below; only the first needs a floor.
